en.title: Setting Target Distances and Face Sizes
en.excerpt: How to configure shooting line distances, target face dimensions, and scoring ring scoring zones in Archeris.
en.content:
Configuring Shooting Distances

Each category requires an explicit shooting distance configured in meters (e.g., 10m, 15m, 20m, 30m, 50m, 60m, or 70m). This distance is automatically displayed on target allocation sheets and athlete match schedules.

Standard Target Face Sizes

Select the physical target face size assigned to the division:

  • 122 cm Face: Standard for Recurve 70m, Standar Bow 30m/40m, and developmental classes.
  • 80 cm Full Face: Standard 10-ring face for intermediate distances (30m to 50m).
  • 80 cm 6-Ring Face (Spot): Standard for Compound 50m (outer rings 1-4 omitted).
  • 60 cm & 40 cm Faces: Used for short distance, indoor, and youth categories.

Scoring Zone Configurations

Specify the numeric scoring scale for mobile scorekeepers:

  • Full 10-Zone Scale: Values from 1 to 10, plus inner X-ring (Recurve/Barebow/Standard).
  • Compound 10-X Scale: Inner 10-ring counted as X for World Archery Compound qualification.
  • Hit/Miss Scale: Used for specialized traditional or recreational flight rounds.

Multi-Distance Qualification Rounds

For double-distance tournaments (e.g., 70m Session 1 followed by 60m Session 2), configure multi-session parameters within the qualification management tab.
